# diff-match-patch (vendored browser bundle)

Classic-script browser source bundle for Utility Editor text patching.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Library | diff-match-patch |
| Version | 1.0.5 JavaScript implementation |
| Bundle | `diff-match-patch.js` |
| Source | https://unpkg.com/diff-match-patch@1.0.5/index.js (CommonJS footer removed for classic-script use) |
| Upstream | https://github.com/google/diff-match-patch |
| License | Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`) |
| Global | `window.diff_match_patch`, `window.DIFF_DELETE`, `window.DIFF_INSERT`, `window.DIFF_EQUAL` |

The implementation is the npm package's browser-compatible source loaded directly as a classic script; its CommonJS export footer is omitted because the offline editor does not use a module loader.
